meta.name: reflection
meta.description: Analyze development sessions, capture learnings, and improve Claude Code instructions. Use when the user wants to reflect on a session, improve CLAUDE.md, extract learnings, or optimize AI-human collaboration. Supports two modes: quick (default) focuses on CLAUDE.md improvements, deep mode performs comprehensive session analysis with learning capture.

copy.tagline: 回顾开发过程，提炼经验，优化协作指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望每次开发后都能自动总结改进点
copy.tagline_en: Review development sessions, extract insights, and improve collaboration instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically summarize improvements after each development session

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析当前对话，找出改进点，并更新项目根目录的 CLAUDE.md 文件，让未来的回答更准确。
howto.when: 当你输入 /reflection（快速模式）或 /reflection deep（深度模式）时触发。默认使用快速模式。

say.text: 请反思这次对话，改进 CLAUDE.md。
say.note: 触发快速模式，分析并更新指令。

say.text: 用深度模式分析本次会话。
say.note: 触发深度模式，进行全面分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the current conversation, identifies improvements, and updates the CLAUDE.md file in the project root to make future responses more accurate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /reflection (quick mode) or /reflection deep (deep mode). Defaults to quick mode.

say_en.text: Reflect on this session and improve CLAUDE.md.
say_en.note: Triggers quick mode to analyze and update instructions.

say_en.text: Analyze this session in deep mode.
say_en.note: Triggers deep mode for comprehensive analysis.
